name: Workshop decoration
purpose: Preview, buy or equip six room cosmetics with exact cost and undo rules.
on_enter: Snapshot equipped cosmetic IDs and balance. Load six catalogue definitions, show four tiles per page.
If Free Play, all cosmetics can be equipped without changing earned ownership or wallet. Hide coin counter.
Preview changes only a separate previewRoomState; do not change persistent room until Confirm.
on_exit: Discard unconfirmed preview. Keep confirmed ownership/equipped state. Expire purchase undo token on normal exit.
persistence: Purchase transaction writes wallet, ownership, equip and spendLedger keyed actionId. Same-visit undo can reverse only the last un-undone purchase, before another purchase or leaving14.
back_rule: Back cancels preview first; second Back02. Home02 discards preview. Owned item confirmation equips without a coin transaction.
acceptance: Preview does not spend. Balance cannot go negative on duplicate confirm.
Purchased cosmetic never changes control icon meaning or access to creation.
Undo exactly restores prior wallet/ownership/equipment once.
implementation_notes: Costs and default slots are in global economy table. Cabinet, cushion, wall art and plant are separate equip slots.
After exit, Undo still reverses unconfirmed previews but not historical purchases. No real money or paid currency exists.

actions.command: Set preview equip slot; show exact price token if unowned and not Free Play
actions.feedback: Room target crossfades 250ms; persistent room unchanged.
actions.interrupt: Another preview replaces current preview, no spend/refund.

actions.trigger: Tap confirm then pictorial price confirmation when unowned
actions.guard: Preview valid; no transaction; balance>=price unless owned/FreePlay
actions.command: Owned: equip. FreePlay: temporary equip access. Unowned: atomic spend+own+equip; create one undo token.
actions.feedback: Confirm check after commit; coin count is true committed balance.
actions.interrupt: Insufficient balance shows cost/progress pictorially and cancel; no ad-watch or purchase offer.

actions.guard: Preview exists OR current-visit last purchase undo token valid
actions.command: First discard unconfirmed preview; else atomic inverse of last eligible purchase using reversal ledger key
actions.state_write: Restore captured prior wallet/ownership/equip once; consume token.
actions.feedback: Room returns to exact prior look.
actions.interrupt: New purchase invalidates old token. Retry inverse uses same key. No multiple refunds.

actions.command: Change tile page retaining current preview
